title: MV More weapons/changing sprite sheet when changing weapons in chrono engine?

posts.author: Gl4ss0nyx
posts.body: So I’ve been using Chronoengine for quite some time learning its mechanics and how to make things work for my current project I’m working on, it’s been a lot of trial and error as a solo dev doing game dev for the first time. One of my characters in my game has the ability to use multiple weapons, like a sword, the bow, and a spear. I wanted to add in a few more weapons for variety, like different swords, or maybe even a gun with bullets for ammunition. I know as a base I’d want to start with the tool map and copy and paste and tweak a few things for each weapon. My question would be if I made a new weapon (ex a gun or a different kind of sword) how would I go about changing the sprite sheet animation for each new weapon? Also with swords would I have to completely change the name of each sword sprite sheet so it doesn’t show the same sprite sheet animation for every sword weapon? Lastly with the gun/bullets I’ve heard with bullets they tend to react like arrows and stick to walls and stuff, is there any way to turn that off and make them disappear in a certain amount of frames or something if it doesn’t hit an enemy?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Gl4ss0nyx said:
My question would be if I made a new weapon (ex a gun or a different kind of sword) how would I go about changing the sprite sheet animation for each new weapon?
Click to expand...
You change the character pose suffix in the tool event page and have corresponding character image files to match it.
Gl4ss0nyx said:
Also with swords would I have to completely change the name of each sword sprite sheet so it doesn’t show the same sprite sheet animation for every sword weapon?
Click to expand...
You would have to have separate sprite sheets for every different looking weapon, even if it's the same type of weapon
Gl4ss0nyx said:
Lastly with the gun/bullets I’ve heard with bullets they tend to react like arrows and stick to walls and stuff, is there any way to turn that off and make them disappear in a certain amount of frames or something if it doesn’t hit an enemy?
Click to expand...
You put erase event in the last line of the tool event's autonomous move route. If you're using Cross Engine it has a bunch of extra bullet features over vanilla Chrono Engine

posts.author: Gl4ss0nyx
posts.body: Okay I think I got it for the most part, my only issue now is figuring out how I’d go about making tool id’s for my new weapons, is there any certain way I should go about it? Other than a few skills I haven’t messed with adding any items to the tool map or anything, is it dependent on where items/skills are? I’m using the bow and arrow as a base for my gun and ammo. Also for adding new weapons like new melee weapons; just wanted to clarify do I have to make new events on the tool map for every weapon? I figured I would but just wanted to double check before diving in head first. Thank you again! This is very helpful!

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: The tool ID is just the event ID on the tool map. If you want different graphics for each tool you're going to have to make new tool events since the tool suffix data is in a comment on the tool event.
